'''327-T''' was a [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|WED-15]] [[WED Treadwell repair droid/Legends|Treadwell droid]] serving aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']]. The droid disliked being called by his nickname, '''327'''.

==Biography==
[[File:327-T_FAIL.png|thumb|left|253x253px|327-T fails to notice Ventress]]

327-T was searching through the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} engine room during the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] boarding of the vessel to free [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], but failed to notice [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] dodging his view while setting multiple [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal charges]] onto the [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]. When Ventress nearly completely blew up the room, 327 was still inside, and was caught in the explosion. He was not destroyed, however, but merely trapped by falling debris. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] sensed movement while tracking Ventress, they mistook him for her due to his movement. Luminara freed him and fixed his position on the ground before continuing pursuit.<ref name="Cloak" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Treadwell droid's name is another conspicuous appearance of the digits "327", a recurring number in Lucas' productions.
